title: OpenSearch: Index Template + Alias Migration
description: Migrate Elasticsearch index templates and aliases to OpenSearch, including ILM → ISM policy conversion.

steps.action: Export ES index templates: GET /_index_template and GET /_template (legacy); save to templates.json
steps.verify: templates.json contains all expected template names with mappings and settings

steps.action: Convert ES ILM policies to OpenSearch ISM policies: map ES phases (hot/warm/cold/delete) to ISM states; use ISM API PUT _plugins/_ism/policies/<name>
steps.verify: GET _plugins/_ism/policies returns all migrated policies with correct state transitions

steps.action: Apply index templates to OpenSearch: PUT _index_template/<name> with updated API syntax (composable template format); attach ISM policy via index.plugins.index_state_management.policy_id
steps.verify: GET _index_template/<name> returns correct mappings; test index creation uses template

steps.action: Recreate aliases: POST _aliases with add actions for each existing ES alias; update applications to use alias names instead of concrete index names
steps.verify: GET _cat/aliases shows all aliases pointing to correct indices; application queries succeed via alias
